review: Independent actual-article read for places_1 support batch B
scope: Wikipedia article/body/section and current draft link confirmation only. No draft/evidence edits; this does not re-review primary WEB facts or authorize runtime/catalog use.

articles.actualArticleTitle: Tyre (actual title), URL redirects/normalizes to Tyre, Lebanon

profiles.noteJa: 一覧のEn-haddah項はJoshua 19:21でイッサカル領に割り当てられる町とし、直前のEn-gannim近くに置かれる可能性を列挙順から推測する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Names Joshua 19:21, assigns it to Issachar, and infers proximity to En-gannim only from list order.
profiles.assessmentJa: The entry matches the biblical place; proximity is explicitly an inference, not a fixed location.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はセバムをシブマの異形と説明しています。聖書本文では異なる綴りが使われるため、同一の町と断定できる根拠にはなりません。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Sebam redirects to Sibmah; the Sibmah entry calls Sebam a form used in one case and says the site is unknown.
profiles.assessmentJa: The list supports an orthographic association, but the linked text does not independently establish that every occurrence denotes one place.

profiles.noteJa: ヨシュア記15:52のRumah/Dumah異読を記事が明記し、現代Dūmeとの比定も不確実とする。本文の町名との関連は確認できるが、個別遺跡の同一性は未確定。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: For Joshua 15:52 it notes the Rumah/Dumah manuscript variation and an uncertain association with modern Dūme.
profiles.assessmentJa: The verse-specific name variant is expressly stated; the modern site remains uncertain.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はヨシュア記16:5のAtaroth-addarを直接挙げ、16:2のAtarothとの同一性は可能性として述べる。対象地名との関連は確認できるが、二地点の同一性は未確定。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Joshua 16:5 is named; the article says it may be the same place as Ataroth in 16:2.
profiles.assessmentJa: The article itself presents the place-merger only as a possibility.

profiles.noteJa: 節はJOS15:48のユダ山地の場所と、士師記10章に出るエフライム山地の同名地点を区別する。ここでは前者を扱う。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: It separates the Judah hill-country location in Joshua 15:48 from a Shamir in Ephraim in Judges 10:1–2.
profiles.assessmentJa: Useful identity distinction; the Judah location is not precisely identified.

profiles.noteJa: Elealeh節はモアブの町でNumbersがルベンに割り当てると記し、現代elʿAlを名前の保存地として挙げる。近代地名は古代市の独立考古学確認とは区別する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Calls it a Moabite town, notes its repeated association with Heshbon and allocation to Reuben, and gives modern elʿAl as the location name.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct place entry and textual territory fit; modern identification is the article’s claim.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧表はベト・エシモテをヨルダン川東側の町として挙げ、スウェイメとの同定を候補説として示す。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Connects Numbers 33:49 and Joshua 12:3/13:20, the Reuben allotment, alternate spellings, and a common identification with Sweimeh in Jordan.
profiles.assessmentJa: Textual match is direct; the modern village identification is expressly conventional rather than certain.

profiles.noteJa: Iphtah-el節はJoshua 19:14,27の場所名とZebulun北境、Asher領に接する位置関係を記す。Khirbet Japhetはprobablyとされる候補であって確定同定ではない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Explains the Joshua 19:14,27 border location between Zebulun and Asher and says Khirbet Japhet is probable.
profiles.assessmentJa: The verses and border setting match; the proposed modern site is marked probable.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧のDilean項はJoshua 15:38とユダのシェフェラの町であることを明示し、場所を不明としたうえで町の列挙順から北方の可能性を述べる。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Joshua 15:38, Judah and the Shephelah are stated; the site is unknown and a north-of-Lachish/Eglon position is inferred from list order.
profiles.assessmentJa: The exact place is not identified; the article labels the directional placement as an inference.

profiles.noteJa: Sibmah節はNumbers 32:37–38のルベン領町とし、32:3のSebamを異形と説明する。所在地は不明。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Numbers 32:37–38 and Joshua 13:19 place it in Reuben; variants include Shibmah/Sebam/Shebam; site unknown.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct verse/name association; no modern point identification is supported.

profiles.noteJa: Beon項目は綴りの異同とMeonとの関係を一説として紹介し、Baal-Meonと同一とは断定しない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Numbers 32:3 is its sole mention and a copying error for Meon is suggested.
profiles.assessmentJa: The article supports the name’s textual occurrence but leaves the reading uncertain.

profiles.noteJa: 節はJOS19:42のShaalabbinをダン領の地名として示し、Shaalbimとの同一性を「likely」とし、Salbitを一般的な現代比定として挙げる。後代の記事上の関係説・候補地であって確定測量ではない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: The entry says Joshua 19:42 Shaalabbin is likely the Shaalbim of Judges 3:5 and 1 Kings 4:9; Salbit is the general location proposal.
profiles.assessmentJa: This directly supports the current cross-spelling link, but states it as likely rather than certain.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧のアズノテ・タボル項はナフタリ領の場所として記し、ヒルベト・エル・ジュベイルを候補とするが、これは確定比定ではない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Places it in Naphtali and proposes Khirbet el-Jebeil, probably north of Mount Tabor.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct entry; site proposal is explicitly probable.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧の項はJoshua 15:27でユダ領に属した場所とし、位置は確定せず南縁の可能性を記す。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Joshua 15:27 and Nehemiah 11:26 are cited; variant spellings are given and the location is uncertain, perhaps near Judah’s southern border.
profiles.assessmentJa: Name and verse match; location is explicitly uncertain.

profiles.noteJa: Hazar-enan項目は境界地名の表記や語義を扱うが、現代の所在地は示していない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Names Hazar-enan/Hazar Enan/Hazarenan as a location on Ezekiel 47:17’s idealized northeastern border; gives a Targum rendering and notes a proposed textual variant in Ezekiel.
profiles.assessmentJa: The page is related to the name and boundary tradition, but its cited passage is Ezekiel rather than Numbers 34; it does not verify the Numbers location independently.

profiles.noteJa: 「Names and etymology」節は、ヘブライ語聖書で地中海を「Great Sea」と呼ぶ用例を示す。民数記34章の海域境界としての関連を補う。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: The article records the Roman name Mare Magnum, translated “Great Sea.”
profiles.assessmentJa: Supports a name association for the water body, but this section does not itself establish the Bible’s English phrase as an ancient Hebrew name.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は地理的地域としてのMidianに加えて部族連合を論じ、地理的範囲も議論がある。22:4の elders は人々を指す用法であり、この記事だけで固定範囲を証明しない。
profiles.sectionAndLines: Lead, lines 155–157; Hebrew Bible section, lines 208–212
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: The lead describes a modern Tabuk-region geographic region and notes scholarly proposals that “Midian” originally denoted a tribal confederation; Bible section discusses scriptural usages.
profiles.assessmentJa: Relevant background, not proof of exact ancient borders or of a single stable geographic extent.

profiles.noteJa: 「Ancient places named Migdol or Migdal」節は出エジプトの宿営地としてのMigdolに触れるが、民数記33:7の個別地点や現代位置は特定しない。
profiles.sectionAndLines: § Ancient places named Migdol or Migdal, lines 134–142
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: It describes the Exodus encampment between Migdol and the sea, then separate Egyptian Migdol/Magdalu proposals and archaeological sites.
profiles.assessmentJa: The section is relevant but does not establish which ancient Migdol is the candidate in Numbers 33:7; profile must preserve that distinction.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は北部のカルメル山地を扱い、名称が指す範囲には複数の用法があります。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Describes a northern Israel coastal mountain range; the article distinguishes uses of “Mount Carmel” at different geographic scales.
profiles.assessmentJa: Related topographic background; a broad modern range should not be treated as exact proof of the biblical Carmel location.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はナーブルス北方の山を対象とし、聖書上のエバル山として記述する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Identifies Ebal near biblical Shechem/Nablus, north of the valley opposite Gerizim; summarizes differing textual traditions about altar instructions.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct name and geographic relationship fit. Historical textual debate does not affect the place identification.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はナーブルスと古代シェケム近郊の山を主題とし、エバル山との位置関係を説明する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Locates Gerizim by Nablus and biblical Shechem, on the south side of the valley opposite Ebal; describes its biblical ceremony association.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct geographic and biblical association.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はシリア・レバノン境界の山群を扱う。現代の主権・管理境界を古代本文の地理的帰属へ遡及させない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Describes a mountain cluster at the southern Anti-Lebanon end, with a summit on the Syria–Lebanon border and multiple peaks.
profiles.assessmentJa: Name/topographic relation fits; current national borders are modern and must not be projected onto the biblical boundary.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は北境のホル山をエドム側の同名山と区別し、所在地比定には諸説を示す。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Separates a second Mount Hor in Numbers 34:7–8, identifies it as a northern land boundary, and reports traditional Nur/Amanus range identifications.
profiles.assessmentJa: Correctly distinguishes the northern boundary feature from Edomite Mount Hor; traditional identification is not certain.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は聖書のホル山と伝統的な位置比定を扱っていますが、正確な所在地には議論があります。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Identifies the Edom-border mountain where Aaron died; Jebel Harun is customary identification while Jebel Madara is an alternative.
profiles.assessmentJa: Correct place-section match, but the article documents competing proposed sites.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は聖書のPisgahを山頂または高地として扱い、ネボ山などとの関係を説明する。民数記21:20の地形語から単一の現代山頂を確定する根拠にはしない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Pisgah is rendered by some translators as a mountain name, often associated with Nebo; the article describes an east-Jordan cluster/region and records uncertain naming.
profiles.assessmentJa: Relevant geographical background, not precise identification of every biblical Pisgah occurrence.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はPisgahを山頂・高地名として扱い、ネボ山などとの関係を説明しますが、ヨシュア記12:3の斜面を特定しません。関連資料として示し、同一の峰や境界を確定する根拠にはしません。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: The section quotes Deuteronomy’s account of Moses viewing the land from Pisgah/Nebo; it does not discuss Joshua 12:3’s “slopes of Pisgah.”
profiles.assessmentJa: Related biblical section only; it does not verify the particular Joshua usage or establish its exact feature.

profiles.noteJa: 記事のBiblical節は聖書のNegebの範囲が現代ネゲブより北側に限られた可能性と、語の「南」という用法を記す。民数記13:17のSouthが地名か方位かは本文だけでは確定しない。
profiles.sectionAndLines: § Biblical / Extent of biblical Negev / Biblical reference, lines 441–452
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Says biblical “Negev” may refer to the northern semi-arid part of the modern Negev; mentions Numbers 13:17 and notes the term can also mean south.
profiles.assessmentJa: Relevant semantic distinction; scope of the ancient region differs from the modern administrative/geographic region.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は現代のガリラヤ湖を対象とし、湖名の語源・聖書上のChinnereth/Gennesaretとの呼称関係を説明する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: The article identifies the modern lake as Kinneret and says the Hebrew Bible uses “sea of Kineret” in Numbers 34:11 and Joshua 13:27, with Kinerot at Joshua 11:2. It distinguishes the city Kinneret.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct waterbody/name relationship, while explicitly avoiding confusion with the separate city of Kinneret.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はTell Balataに位置する古代都市シェケムを説明し、エフライム領内にあったとする。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: The article distinguishes the biblical city from Nablus, the person, and Manasseh’s son; says ancient city is now identified with nearby Tell Balata.
profiles.assessmentJa: Correct ancient city article; it clearly warns against the homonymous people and modern city.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は聖書の古代都市シロを主題とし、キルベト・セイルーンへの比定を記す。現代のShilo集落と古代遺跡は別物として扱う。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Describes an ancient city/sanctuary and identifies it with Khirbet Seilun/Tel Shiloh, west of modern Israeli settlement Shilo.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct city and site relationship, with modern settlement distinction explicit.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は曖昧さ回避ページで、聖書の場所としてAbel-Shittim/Ha-Shittimを示し、別の現代のShitim集落とも分ける。これだけではヨシュア記の宿営地の正確な位置を確定しない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Separates acacia terminology, biblical place names Abel-Shittim/Ha-Shittim/Shittim later associated with Abila, and the modern Israeli village Shitim.
profiles.assessmentJa: This is a disambiguation page, not proof of a precise Joshua-era site; link is contextual only.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧表はBene-Jaakanを旅程上の地名として挙げ、位置には複数説を示す。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Lists Bene-Jaakan at Numbers 33:31–32; possible location Birein near Nitzana.
profiles.assessmentJa: Textual station match; modern site is a proposal.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧表はTerahを旅程上の地名として挙げ、複数の現代位置候補を示す。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Lists Terah at Numbers 33:27–28 and offers two possible sites.
profiles.assessmentJa: Textual station match; location is explicitly uncertain.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧表はEthamを旅程上の宿営地として挙げ、「荒野の端」とする説明を載せる。現代位置は不明確。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Etham is linked to Exodus 13:20/Numbers 33:6–8 and described at wilderness edge; proposed site is unknown, perhaps near Ismailia.
profiles.assessmentJa: Correct station/name, but location expressly unknown/proposed.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧表はRithmahを旅程上の宿営地として挙げ、Wadi el-Rutmi説を紹介するが、位置は確定していない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Lists Rithmah at Numbers 33:18–19 and offers Wadi el-Rutmi as a possible location.
profiles.assessmentJa: Textual station match; location is only a proposal.

profiles.noteJa: 一覧表はLibnahを旅程上の宿営地として挙げ、複数の現代位置候補を示す。ユダの同名都市とは区別する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Lists Libnah at Numbers 33:20–21 and offers two possible locations.
profiles.assessmentJa: Textual station match; alternate site proposals remain unresolved.

profiles.noteJa: 記事はユダ領のテルと、ヨシュア記19:38のナフタリ領の同名町を区別して明記する。対象の町名・領域との関係は確認できるが、このテルを対象町の遺跡と同定する根拠にはならない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Distinguishes Judah’s Beth Shemesh in Joshua 15:10/21:16 from another city of the same name in Naphtali at Joshua 19:38.
profiles.assessmentJa: The article is useful for disambiguation, but this profile’s exact occurrence must match the corresponding Judah or Naphtali city; it does not collapse them.

profiles.noteJa: 記事は聖書の「要塞都市ティルス」をヨシュア記19章の記述と結び、古代の島都市・本土の集落と現代の市街を区別する。
profiles.articleTitle: Tyre (actual title), URL redirects/normalizes to Tyre, Lebanon
profiles.sectionAndLines: Lead and § Territory, lines 251–258; history lines 716–718 contain Joshua reference
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Describes modern Tyre and explains ancient island city plus mainland settlement; the article’s Joshua citation identifies a fortified city of Tyre assigned to Asher.
profiles.assessmentJa: The historic name link is supported; present city limits and the ancient island/mainland arrangement are distinct.

profiles.noteJa: WikipediaはJabbokを現代Zarqa Riverの古名として案内する関連記事。河川同一視を資料だけで確定せず、聖書文脈との対応を注記する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Explicitly identifies Zarqa River with biblical Jabbok and describes the river/boundary in biblical narrative.
profiles.assessmentJa: Directly supports the name relation, though a river corridor is not a pinpoint city.

profiles.noteJa: Biblical Jabbok節は現ザルカ川を聖書のヤボクと同定し、民数記21:24を引く。河川全体の代表点・座標を確定する根拠にはしない。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: Explicitly identifies the modern Zarqa River with biblical Jabbok and cites Numbers 21:24 for the Arnon-to-Jabbok boundary.
profiles.assessmentJa: Direct name relation and Numbers context match; avoid claiming one exact point along the river.

profiles.noteJa: 日本語記事は現代ネゲヴ砂漠を主題とする。聖書のNegebは現代地域全体と同じ範囲ではないため、本文中の「南」「南地」と結びつける範囲は限定して表示する。
profiles.articleContentParaphraseJa: 日本語記事はネゲヴをイスラエル南部の砂漠地帯と説明し、聖書の普通名詞の「南」と地名としての「ネゲブ」を区別している。
profiles.assessmentJa: 日本語で語義差を確認できるが、現代の砂漠域全体がヨシュア記の境界地名と同一範囲とは限らない。

summaryJa: 20割当記事URL、41プロフィール行を実読。固定URLと現草稿SHAの不一致は0件。直リンクと限定的な関連記事を区別し、古代地名と現代地形の比定が確定していない箇所はqualifiedとした。
limitationsJa: This is an independent read of the assigned article content, not a claim that Wikipedia is authoritative for ancient geography. Sections making probable, traditional, or disputed identifications remain qualified. No candidate profile was edited.
